Hey [nation]Tan Srpka[/nation] , instead of going for an imidiate and tottal blockade of the Shamat straight, and potentialy pissing of a lot of people/nations, why not go for a blockade of [b]only[/b] millitary and directly '[i]hostile nations[/i]' ships instead?
This way you block it off from the intended hostile navies and any potentualy hostile ones without blocking of the flow of trade, goods and people coming to or from other nations that are neutral or friendly (or linked to you friends/allies that you don't yet know of), and since you will still have military ships and troops there this way you can still monitor and quickly respond to anyting happening without making a lot of new potential enemies (or give your enemies new potential allies or suporters).

This will also be much more defendable in a diplomatic sense on the world stage.
